description: Read the input rules, allowed values, output shape and pricing for the tavern menu workflow: create a tavern menu lettered with tavernName and dishes (one dish and its price per line, up to four), optionally from an owned tavern image. Takes no arguments and never starts a run. Use chargen_quote_recipe_tavern_menu to price exact values and chargen_run_recipe_tavern_menu to start this workflow.
name: chargen_get_recipe_tavern_menu
title: Get tavern menu
